verdict.rationale: uv supports `uv python pin 3.11` which writes a checked-in `.python-version` file, and `uv python install` to install runtimes, plus `uv tool install`/`uvx` for per-project tool versions pinned via pyproject.toml/lockfile. This directly matches installing/switching runtimes or tool versions from a checked-in config file. Missing for 10: independent hands-on confirmation specifically of `.python-version` switching behavior across projects (only vendor docs/GitHub README cited) and no community corroboration of multi-project runtime switching workflow.
